memberdef.name: scanRange

briefdescription.para: Scan a key range [start_key, end_key) in sorted order.

detaileddescription.para: Iterates all keys ≥ start_key and < end_key (pass empty strings for open-ended bounds) and calls callback for each key-value pair. Returning false from the callback stops iteration early.
Updates ScanCounters atomically.

simplesect.para: Result<void> – ok on success, error on failure.

memberdef.name: scanPredicate

briefdescription.para: Scan a key range with an inline predicate filter.

detaileddescription.para: Like scanRange() but only delivers key-value pairs for which predicate returns true. The predicate is evaluated for every key visited; if it returns false the entry is counted as "examined but not returned" (keys_examined++ only).
Updates ScanCounters atomically.

parameterdescription.para: Returns true if the entry should be delivered.
Called only for entries that pass the predicate. Return false to stop iteration.

simplesect.para: Result<void> – ok on success, error on failure.

briefdescription.para: Storage Engine implementation with Dependency Injection.

detaileddescription.para:
This class demonstrates the Dependency Inversion Principle by:
Depending on abstractions (interfaces) instead of concrete implementations
Allowing injection of query evaluation, encryption, and key management
Breaking circular dependencies between Storage, Query, and Security layers

Benefits:
Testable: Can inject mocks for unit testing
Flexible: Can swap implementations without recompiling
Explicit: Dependencies are clearly documented in constructor
Decoupled: No concrete dependencies on QueryEngine or FieldEncryption
